224    /**
225     * Compile the Blade component string for the given component and attributes.
226     *
227     * @param  string  $component
228     * @param  array  $attributes
229     * @return string
230     *
231     * @throws \InvalidArgumentException
232     */
233    protected function componentString(string $component, array $attributes)
234    {
235        $class = $this->componentClass($component);
236
237        [$data, $attributes] = $this->partitionDataAndAttributes($class, $attributes);
238
239        $data = $data->mapWithKeys(function ($value, $key) {
240            return [Str::camel($key) => $value];
241        });
242
243        // If the component doesn't exist as a class, we'll assume it's a class-less
244        // component and pass the component as a view parameter to the data so it
245        // can be accessed within the component and we can render out the view.
246        if (! class_exists($class)) {
247            $view = Str::startsWith($component, 'mail::')
248                ? "\$__env->getContainer()->make(Illuminate\\View\\Factory::class)->make('{$component}')"
249                : "'$class'";
250
251            $parameters = [
252                'view' => $view,
253                'data' => '['.$this->attributesToString($data->all(), $escapeBound = false).']',
254            ];
255
256            $class = AnonymousComponent::class;
257        } else {
258            $parameters = $data->all();
259        }
260
261        return "##BEGIN-COMPONENT-CLASS##@component('{$class}', '{$component}', [".$this->attributesToString($parameters, $escapeBound = false).'])
262<?php if (isset($attributes) && $attributes instanceof Illuminate\View\ComponentAttributeBag): ?>
263<?php $attributes = $attributes->except(\\'.$class.'::ignoredParameterNames()); ?>
264<?php endif; ?>
265<?php $component->withAttributes(['.$this->attributesToString($attributes->all(), $escapeAttributes = $class !== DynamicComponent::class).']); ?>';
266    }

268    /**
269     * Get the component class for a given component alias.
270     *
271     * @param  string  $component
272     * @return string
273     *
274     * @throws \InvalidArgumentException
275     */
276    public function componentClass(string $component)
277    {
278        $viewFactory = Container::getInstance()->make(Factory::class);
279
280        if (isset($this->aliases[$component])) {
281            if (class_exists($alias = $this->aliases[$component])) {
282                return $alias;
283            }
284
285            if ($viewFactory->exists($alias)) {
286                return $alias;
287            }
288
289            throw new InvalidArgumentException(
290                "Unable to locate class or view [{$alias}] for component [{$component}]."
291            );
292        }
293
294        if ($class = $this->findClassByComponent($component)) {
295            return $class;
296        }
297
298        if (class_exists($class = $this->guessClassName($component))) {
299            return $class;
300        }
301
302        if (class_exists($class = $class.'\\'.Str::afterLast($class, '\\'))) {
303            return $class;
304        }
305
306        if (! is_null($guess = $this->guessAnonymousComponentUsingNamespaces($viewFactory, $component)) ||
307            ! is_null($guess = $this->guessAnonymousComponentUsingPaths($viewFactory, $component))) {
308            return $guess;
309        }
310
311        if (Str::startsWith($component, 'mail::')) {
312            return $component;
313        }
314
315        throw new InvalidArgumentException(
316            "Unable to locate a class or view for component [{$component}]."
317        );
318    }

320    /**
321     * Attempt to find an anonymous component using the registered anonymous component paths.
322     *
323     * @param  \Illuminate\Contracts\View\Factory  $viewFactory
324     * @param  string  $component
325     * @return string|null
326     */
327    protected function guessAnonymousComponentUsingPaths(Factory $viewFactory, string $component)
328    {
329        $delimiter = ViewFinderInterface::HINT_PATH_DELIMITER;
330
331        foreach ($this->blade->getAnonymousComponentPaths() as $path) {
332            try {
333                if (str_contains($component, $delimiter) &&
334                    ! str_starts_with($component, $path['prefix'].$delimiter)) {
335                    continue;
336                }
337
338                $formattedComponent = str_starts_with($component, $path['prefix'].$delimiter)
339                    ? Str::after($component, $delimiter)
340                    : $component;
341
342                if (! is_null($guess = match (true) {
343                    $viewFactory->exists($guess = $path['prefixHash'].$delimiter.$formattedComponent) => $guess,
344                    $viewFactory->exists($guess = $path['prefixHash'].$delimiter.$formattedComponent.'.index') => $guess,
345                    $viewFactory->exists($guess = $path['prefixHash'].$delimiter.$formattedComponent.'.'.Str::afterLast($formattedComponent, '.')) => $guess,
346                    default => null,
347                })) {
348                    return $guess;
349                }
350            } catch (InvalidArgumentException) {
351                //
352            }
353        }
354    }
355
356    /**
357     * Attempt to find an anonymous component using the registered anonymous component namespaces.
358     *
359     * @param  \Illuminate\Contracts\View\Factory  $viewFactory
360     * @param  string  $component
361     * @return string|null
362     */
363    protected function guessAnonymousComponentUsingNamespaces(Factory $viewFactory, string $component)
364    {
365        return (new Collection($this->blade->getAnonymousComponentNamespaces()))
366            ->filter(function ($directory, $prefix) use ($component) {
367                return Str::startsWith($component, $prefix.'::');
368            })
369            ->prepend('components', $component)
370            ->reduce(function ($carry, $directory, $prefix) use ($component, $viewFactory) {
371                if (! is_null($carry)) {
372                    return $carry;
373                }
374
375                $componentName = Str::after($component, $prefix.'::');
376
377                if ($viewFactory->exists($view = $this->guessViewName($componentName, $directory))) {
378                    return $view;
379                }
380
381                if ($viewFactory->exists($view = $this->guessViewName($componentName, $directory).'.index')) {
382                    return $view;
383                }
384
385                $lastViewSegment = Str::afterLast(Str::afterLast($componentName, '.'), ':');
386
387                if ($viewFactory->exists($view = $this->guessViewName($componentName, $directory).'.'.$lastViewSegment)) {
388                    return $view;
389                }
390            });
391    }

393    /**
394     * Find the class for the given component using the registered namespaces.
395     *
396     * @param  string  $component
397     * @return string|null
398     */
399    public function findClassByComponent(string $component)
400    {
401        $segments = explode('::', $component);
402
403        $prefix = $segments[0];
404
405        if (! isset($this->namespaces[$prefix], $segments[1])) {
406            return;
407        }
408
409        if (class_exists($class = $this->namespaces[$prefix].'\\'.$this->formatClassName($segments[1]))) {
410            return $class;
411        }
412
413        if (class_exists($class = $class.'\\'.Str::afterLast($class, '\\'))) {
414            return $class;
415        }
416    }

418    /**
419     * Guess the class name for the given component.
420     *
421     * @param  string  $component
422     * @return string
423     */
424    public function guessClassName(string $component)
425    {
426        $namespace = Container::getInstance()
427            ->make(Application::class)
428            ->getNamespace();
429
430        $class = $this->formatClassName($component);
431
432        return $namespace.'View\\Components\\'.$class;
433    }
434
435    /**
436     * Format the class name for the given component.
437     *
438     * @param  string  $component
439     * @return string
440     */
441    public function formatClassName(string $component)
442    {
443        $componentPieces = array_map(function ($componentPiece) {
444            return ucfirst(Str::camel($componentPiece));
445        }, explode('.', $component));
446
447        return implode('\\', $componentPieces);
448    }
449
450    /**
451     * Guess the view name for the given component.
452     *
453     * @param  string  $name
454     * @param  string  $prefix
455     * @return string
456     */
457    public function guessViewName($name, $prefix = 'components.')
458    {
459        if (! Str::endsWith($prefix, '.')) {
460            $prefix .= '.';
461        }
462
463        $delimiter = ViewFinderInterface::HINT_PATH_DELIMITER;
464
465        if (str_contains($name, $delimiter)) {
466            return Str::replaceFirst($delimiter, $delimiter.$prefix, $name);
467        }
468
469        return $prefix.$name;
470    }

472    /**
473     * Partition the data and extra attributes from the given array of attributes.
474     *
475     * @param  string  $class
476     * @param  array  $attributes
477     * @return array
478     */
479    public function partitionDataAndAttributes($class, array $attributes)
480    {
481        // If the class doesn't exist, we'll assume it is a class-less component and
482        // return all of the attributes as both data and attributes since we have
483        // now way to partition them. The user can exclude attributes manually.
484        if (! class_exists($class)) {
485            return [new Collection($attributes), new Collection($attributes)];
486        }
487
488        $constructor = (new ReflectionClass($class))->getConstructor();
489
490        $parameterNames = $constructor
491            ? (new Collection($constructor->getParameters()))->map->getName()->all()
492            : [];
493
494        return (new Collection($attributes))
495            ->partition(fn ($value, $key) => in_array(Str::camel($key), $parameterNames))

528                        (?:
529                            (?:

532                            |
533                            (?:
534                                @(?:style)(\( (?: (?>[^()]+) | (?-1) )* \))
535                            )
536                            |
537                            (?:
538                                \{\{\s*\\\$attributes(?:[^}]+?)?\s*\}\}
539                            )
540                            |
541                            (?:
542                                [\w\-:.@]+
543                                (
544                                    =
545                                    (?:
546                                        \\\"[^\\\"]*\\\"
547                                        |
548                                        \'[^\']*\'
549                                        |
550                                        [^\'\\\"=<>]+
551                                    )
552                                )?
553                            )
554                        )
555                    )*
556                    \s*
557                )

565            if (Str::contains($name, '-') && ! empty($matches['inlineName'])) {

591    /**
592     * Get an array of attributes from the given attribute string.
593     *
594     * @param  string  $attributeString
595     * @return array
596     */
597    protected function getAttributesFromAttributeString(string $attributeString)
598    {
599        $attributeString = $this->parseShortAttributeSyntax($attributeString);
600        $attributeString = $this->parseAttributeBag($attributeString);
601        $attributeString = $this->parseComponentTagClassStatements($attributeString);
602        $attributeString = $this->parseComponentTagStyleStatements($attributeString);
603        $attributeString = $this->parseBindAttributes($attributeString);
604
605        $pattern = '/
606            (?<attribute>[\w\-:.@%]+)
607            (
608                =
609                (?<value>
610                    (
611                        \"[^\"]+\"
612                        |
613                        \\\'[^\\\']+\\\'
614                        |
615                        [^\s>]+
616                    )
617                )
618            )?
619        /x';
620
621        if (! preg_match_all($pattern, $attributeString, $matches, PREG_SET_ORDER)) {
622            return [];
623        }
624
625        return (new Collection($matches))->mapWithKeys(function ($match) {
626            $attribute = $match['attribute'];
627            $value = $match['value'] ?? null;
628
629            if (is_null($value)) {
630                $value = 'true';
631
632                $attribute = Str::start($attribute, 'bind:');
633            }
634
635            $value = $this->stripQuotes($value);
636
637            if (str_starts_with($attribute, 'bind:')) {
638                $attribute = Str::after($attribute, 'bind:');
639
640                $this->boundAttributes[$attribute] = true;
641            } else {
642                $value = "'".$this->compileAttributeEchos($value)."'";
643            }
644
645            if (str_starts_with($attribute, '::')) {
646                $attribute = substr($attribute, 1);
647            }
648
649            return [$attribute => $value];
650        })->toArray();
651    }

653    /**
654     * Parses a short attribute syntax like :$foo into a fully-qualified syntax like :foo="$foo".

656     * @param  string  $value
657     * @return string
658     */

660    {

663        return preg_replace_callback($pattern, function (array $matches) {
664            return " :{$matches[1]}=\"\${$matches[1]}\"";
665        }, $value);

672     * @return string
673     */

675    {

678            \{\{\s*(\\\$attributes(?:[^}]+?(?<!\s))?)\s*\}\} # exact match of attributes variable being echoed

729     * @param  string  $attributeString
730     * @return string
731     */
732    protected function parseBindAttributes(string $attributeString)
733    {
734        $pattern = "/
735            (?:^|\s+)     # start of the string or whitespace between attributes
736            :(?!:)        # attribute needs to start with a single colon
737            ([\w\-:.@]+)  # match the actual attribute name
738            =             # only match attributes that have a value
739        /xm";

744    /**

748     *

753    {

764    /**
765     * Escape the single quotes in the given string that are outside of PHP blocks.
766     *
767     * @param  string  $value
768     * @return string
769     */
770    protected function escapeSingleQuotesOutsideOfPhpBlocks(string $value)
771    {
772        return (new Collection(token_get_all($value)))->map(function ($token) {
773            if (! is_array($token)) {
774                return $token;
775            }
776
777            return $token[0] === T_INLINE_HTML
778                ? str_replace("'", "\\'", $token[1])
779                : $token[1];
780        })->implode('');
